name: popover
title: Popover
description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: Trigger render-prop — the element that opens the popover.

parts.name: title
parts.description: Title of the popover, automatically wired to aria-labelledby.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description:
Whether to automatically set focus on the first focusable
content within the popover when opened.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra class for the content panel.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether to close the popover when the escape key is pressed.

props.name: closeOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether to close the popover when the user clicks outside of the popover.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the popover when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the popover.

props.name: defaultTriggerValue
props.description:
The initial trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the trigger value.

props.name: finalFocusEl
props.description: Element to receive focus when the popover is closed.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the popover. Useful for composition.

props.name: initialFocusEl
props.description: The element to focus on when the popover is opened.

props.name: modal
props.description:
Whether the popover should be modal. When set to `true`:
- interaction with outside elements will be disabled
- only popover content will be visible to screen readers
- scrolling is blocked
- focus is trapped within the popover

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the popover

props.name: persistentElements
props.description:
Returns the persistent elements that:
- should not have pointer-events disabled
- should not trigger the dismiss event

props.name: portalled
props.description:
Whether the popover is portalled. This will proxy the tabbing behavior regardless of the DOM position
of the popover content.

props.name: positioning
props.description: The user provided options used to position the popover content

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Whether to restore focus to the element that had focus before the popover was opened.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

events.name: onEscapeKeyDown
events.description: Function called when the escape key is pressed

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Function invoked when the popover opens or closes

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

events.name: onRequestDismiss
events.description: Function called when this layer is closed due to a parent layer being closed

events.name: onTriggerValueChange
events.description: Function called when the trigger value changes.

body.description: Popover content shown when open. Optional — a title/description-only popover is legitimate.

composition:
`Popover` is a single-file component. Its two upstream parts map onto slots on one tag:

- `<@trigger|props|>` — render-prop slot; spread `props` onto your own trigger element (a `Button`, typically). Replaces upstream's separate `PopoverTrigger`.
- the tag's own body — rendered inside the floating panel when open. Replaces upstream's separate `PopoverContent`.

Upstream's `PopoverHeader`, `PopoverTitle`, and `PopoverDescription` have no dedicated parts in our port — they're plain markup (an `h4`/`p` pair) composed directly inside the body, as shown in the examples below.
